swiftness.name: Verse of Swiftness
swiftness.text: +15 evade, +1 move. In a clash: +3 agility.

freeClimb.text: A Sage (Layra) hops from one high spot to another: her moves ignore height, and she flies over anyone in her way.

stone.name: Verse of Stone
stone.effectNote: Suleiman 30 Oct: the effect of the Verse of Stone is called Earth's Bulwark. Its short word is EARTH because BULWARK is already the Warden's signature.
stone.text: Earth's Bulwark, +2 defense. In a clash: +3 guard, harder to push.

stillGuard.text: A spearman (Gaha) who doesn't move on his turn plants his feet: half damage, and nothing can push him, until his next turn.

slow.name: Slow
slow.text: Its next turn comes later, and it is slower for 2 turns.

husk.name: Husk
husk.text: Leave a decoy that fools the enemy and slip up to 3 tiles away, even out of a clash. Enemies chase the decoy. If nobody strikes it by your next turn, it echoes your next spell: a second bolt of Lightning, or a Verse or Slow twice as strong.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.text: Sink into a trance: your next turn is spent meditating too (you can't act), then 6 MP come back. You are Exposed until then, so keep allies close.

spearThrow.name: Spear Throw
spearThrow.text: Hurl the spear at an enemy up to 3 tiles away, 1 tile further for each level you stand above it. A hit knocks it back a tile (off a ledge, it falls; into a wall, it slams and is Disoriented). A higher block in the way stops the throw. Ready again after 3 turns.

herbs.name: Herbs
herbs.text: Press healing herbs on yourself or an ally next to you: +10 health, and it cures poison and puts out a burn. Ready again after 3 turns.

poisonArrow.name: Poison Arrow
poisonArrow.text: Take aim this turn; the arrow flies at the start of your next turn if the target is still within reach and in clear sight (a higher block in the way stops it). Half damage, then 3 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns. Poison never takes the last point of health, and Herbs cures it. Ready again after 3 turns.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.text: Charge up to 4 tiles at an enemy and slam it with the shield: half damage, and it's locked in a clash with you. If it was clashing with an ally, you take over and the ally is free. Ready again after 3 turns.

shieldToss.name: Shield Toss
shieldToss.text: Hurl the shield at an enemy up to 3 tiles away (a higher block in the way stops it): half damage, and it is stunned for a turn. A stunned unit loses its next turn, can't dodge, and takes flank hits (+3 damage). Ready again after 3 turns.

doubleHit.name: Double Hit
doubleHit.text: Strike with both heads of the spear: two quick hits on an enemy next to you, each 60% of a normal hit, each rolled on its own. Ready again after 2 turns.

shieldRam.name: Shield Ram
shieldRam.text: Stone turns Intercept into this: charge up to 4 tiles and ram the enemy 2 tiles back, no clash. Into a wall, it slams and is Disoriented. 3 Verse MP.

furyCharge.name: Furious Charge
furyCharge.text: Fury turns Intercept into this: charge up to 4 tiles and hit with your full strength, no clash. 3 Verse MP.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.text: Swiftness turns Intercept into this: a charge too fast to answer. Half damage, and it is stunned for a turn, no clash. 3 Verse MP.

sonicJavelin.name: Sonic Javelin
sonicJavelin.text: Swiftness turns Spear Throw into this. Up close: dash in and whirl the spear down. Further (5 tiles): a throw that hits every enemy in its line, through high blocks. At a reeling foe: zip to it and sweep low (1.5x damage). Never misses. 3 Verse MP.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.text: Stone turns her Lightning into this: the bolt knocks the target a tile back (into a wall, it slams). It still jumps to a second enemy.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.text: Fury turns her Lightning to fire: it sets the target alight, 2 damage a turn for 3 turns (never the last point; Herbs put it out). Fire doesn't jump.
